spec_match.rationale: Builds on the spec's Animatable: yes line for side: the ticker animates startOffset continuously and flips side as runtime state (on demand or every lap), measuring the rendered lane after each flip.

interactive.rationale: Play/pause with aria-pressed, speed slider, manual lane flip, auto-flip-per-lap checkbox, and a live state line with offset, attribute value and measured lane.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises an orbiting ticker whose lane side chooses, driven together with animated startOffset; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the unsupported tier (flip sets attribute, lane measured unchanged, state line says inert) and reduced-motion, but does not exercise declarative SMIL animation of side — the suite's manual assertion notes why.

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, spec section, and MDN startOffset are linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite's side-is-animatable manual assertion names this concept as its measuring instrument; the movement assertions cover the underlying flip contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: the orbit genuinely animates (autorun assert offset>0.5 passed), the autorun lane flip set side=right and the measured lane stayed outside — reported as inert honestly; console clean; mobile emulation overflow-free. The actual lane change requires a 156/Firefox engine.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe, the lane-flip-inert fallback branch, every lane flip with measured lane, and the autorun motion check.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; ring is stone-filled with black stroke, ticker text black on ivory, buttons keep the global style.

accessibility.rationale: Play button exposes aria-pressed, speed slider is labelled with live value, the state line is aria-live, the SVG is role=img with title, and prefers-reduced-motion starts the ticker paused.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360x740 DPR3: zero horizontal overflow, ring scales with min() width, controls stack, no console errors.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for continuous animation and give toggles a pressed state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Reduced motion starts the ticker paused (Play is explicit); the Play button toggles aria-pressed; the state line gives a text equivalent of motion state.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Continuous scroll-linked motion should be driven from a single animation source rather than per-frame style thrash.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: One rAF loop updates only startOffset; announcements are throttled to 5% steps to keep the live region and layout quiet.

openQuestions.title: SMIL animation of side
openQuestions.detail: SVG 2 marks side animatable, which should include SMIL (<set>/<animate> with attributeName=side). Once a supporting engine is available, add a declarative <set side begin='...'> variant beside the scripted flip and verify both flip the measured lane — this is also what the suite's manual assertion needs to be resolved by hand.

openQuestions.title: Continuity of the flip mid-orbit
openQuestions.detail: When side flips mid-flight, does the glyph run continue from the equivalent reversed offset (100-offset) or from the same offset value measured from the other end? Observe on a supporting engine and, if the jump is jarring, demonstrate the offset-compensation trick (set offset to 100-offset at flip time).

summary: Composition piece: continuously animated startOffset orbit with side as the flippable lane state, measured after every flip. On Chromium 141 the orbit runs for real and the flip is honestly reported inert; SMIL animation of side and flip-continuity are the recorded follow-ups for a supporting engine.
